verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows generic AI/DLSS marketing and confirms a 16GB VRAM capacity (via the community GDDR6X comparison), well short of what's needed to run a 70B-class quantized LLM locally; no vendor documentation specifies VRAM/bandwidth sufficient for such workloads. missing for 10: explicit VRAM/bandwidth specs, any benchmark or claim of running 70B-parameter models, quantization guidance for large LLMs on this card.
